_fictional: FICTIONAL RECORDINGS, HAND-WRITTEN, NEVER CAPTURED. This repository has no OPENAI_API_KEY, no GOOGLE_FACTCHECK_API_KEY and no route to either service, so nothing here was recorded from a live API. Each entry is what a plausible provider or model answer would look like for one claim of the fictional golden set — evidence for testing Re-Vera's rules, not evidence about the world, and not evidence that any real model returns these answers. Every outlet, URL, figure and quotation is invented. See eval/fixtures/README.md.

official.quote: Delay incidents on the East-West Line fell 12 per cent in 2025
official.text: Delay incidents on the East-West Line fell 12 per cent in 2025, from 41 to 36 incidents lasting more than five minutes.

judge.evidence: The Land Transport Data Portal records East-West Line delays falling 12 per cent in 2025.
cited_spans: Delay incidents on the East-West Line fell 12 per cent in 2025

web.text: The East-West Line recorded 1.2 million train-kilometres between delays in 2025, up from 1.0 million a year earlier.

judge.evidence: The Rail Regulator publishes 1.2 million train-kilometres between delays for 2025.

cited.quote: we are among the more reliable networks in the region
cited.text: The chief executive said: “On availability we are among the more reliable networks in the region, and we intend to stay there.” No comparison of the kind reported was made.

judge.evidence: The operator briefing transcript has the chief executive calling the network among the more reliable in the region.
cited_spans: we are among the more reliable networks in the region

web.quote: Nine in ten commuters said they were late at least once a week
web.text: Nine in ten commuters said they were late at least once a week, a reader poll published this month found.
The commuter poll was open on the site for four days and drew 60 respondents. The publisher notes it is self-selected and not representative of ridership.

judge.evidence: Harbour Post reports the nine-in-ten figure, but its own methodology note describes a self-selected reader poll.
cited_spans: Nine in ten commuters said they were late at least once a week
